invariants.name: layout_style_does_not_extract_full_tree
invariants.note: Issue #8 §3.2 requires dirty layout-style propagation, not a full 5k extract. Evaluate when work_counters.render_nodes_changed is present.

invariants.name: layout_style_does_not_rebuild_the_hit_index
invariants.note: Resizing one node must patch its hit subtree, not rebuild the 5k document. Deliberately a small constant, not a fraction of tree_nodes. Layout invalidation propagates to ancestors, so a rebuild keyed on scheduled layout instead of written boxes lands back at the document root and fails here. Missing stays not-evaluable.
